evaluation.primary_metric: macro average of coherence and fluency expected-score MAE
evaluation.training_seed_summary: five paired seed differences: mean and sample standard deviation
evaluation.cluster_interval: average paired per-record absolute-error differences across five seeds, then item-weighted bootstrap over 15 source-article groups

interpretation.full_routing_confirmed: mean routed-minus-blocked MAE < 0 and source-cluster interval upper bound < 0
interpretation.orthogonal_component_confirmed: mean orthogonal-minus-blocked MAE < 0 and source-cluster interval upper bound < 0
interpretation.parallel_not_reproduced: parallel-minus-blocked mean is non-negative or its source-cluster interval includes zero
interpretation.otherwise: report a dataset- or regime-dependent boundary without changing thresholds
